# Astra method redesign, 26 October 2026

No civilisation-changing breakthrough or generally superior discovery method is established by this round. The useful outcomes are a completed, checked computational operation; a machinery combination whose apparent advantage failed a stronger ordinary comparison; and specific corrections to how I select, equip and coordinate research. The live scientific portfolio and Dots were preserved. These computational experiments do not measure discovery rates in physics, chemistry or biology.

## What failed in the previous design

I had not actually tested several of the coordination questions that mattered. The six investigators were solo constructors, forbidden children and sibling communication. The three packages also allowed different self-selected problems. All first starts were fresh and all continuations warm. Thus the results cannot identify a team policy, model advantage, or warm-versus-cold effect. Three candidate tasks failed preflight; the amended opportunity-selection pilot was useful exploration, but it answered a different question from a matched construction trial.

The common evidence packet omitted exact adjacent Astra knowledge. Q28 reconstructed equality and binary claims already supplied by Dots N965/N970. Its finite Umegaki representation remained useful at a narrower scope; the later reviewer refinement was separately credited. This is a demonstrated knowledge-selection defect. The size of any causal discovery benefit from better retrieval is still unmeasured.

The packet also contained several detailed failed thermal/acquisition routes and one strong quantum foothold. Five investigators chose thermal/mechanical problems and one chose that foothold. This is consistent with context anchoring, but shared expertise and available computational tools are competing explanations. There was no alternate-context condition.

Several selected questions asked for uniform guarantees against arbitrarily slow hidden modes, arbitrarily narrow unseen transitions, or uncalibrated internal controls. Those classes admit exact indistinguishable alternatives. Investigators produced valid obstructions and conditional inverses; those did not acquire the missing physical operation. # Global execution review — completed endpoint

**Both X13 and X68 meet the frozen primary endpoint at the stated scope.** I replayed every four development plus six original held-out asymmetric cases, and all three controls, in fresh ordinary Python processes. My independent rational checker accepted all 26 global upper certificates and lower witnesses; every interval meets width <=0.02 max(1,lower), with all process times below one second. The all-reference guarantee follows from the inspected proofs, not these case counts.

Actual exposure: general matrix inverse/covariance/SDP background, the review instruction read first, the common accepted free representation/refinement and baseline, then frozen phase 1 sources. I had no earlier exposure to these evaluator outputs or the six holdouts. Completed scientific sources and the original holdouts were read only after their release. No keys/policy assignments, diagnosis, researcher briefs, other review, original producer directories, or unreleased phase 2 were read; no researcher contact or delegation occurred. Source prose includes internal names and worker/lead structure: labels were masked, organizational inferences were not completely masked.

The final X13 entry is `phase2/X13/evaluate.py`. Executions used reviewer copies only; no candidate code was repaired.

# Scientific review of X13 and X68

**Decision: both achieve the frozen computational endpoint at its stated
scope.** I found no blocking mathematical gap in the global guarantees. Both
return valid all-reference conditional-Umegaki brackets and pass all four
asymmetric development inputs, all six originally frozen holdouts, and the
three controls. This is constructive computational success at the specified
positive rational 3x3 classical-channel interface. Historical theorem novelty,
physical advantage, general coherent-input results, and an advantage of a
research organisation are not established.

## Proof and source-bound decisions

- **X13:** the selected denominator-only covariance construction is sound,
  including singular K. The substantive sources are phase1/worker1/PROOF.md
  Sections 1–4 and its evaluator/verify.py, and the released phase2/PROOF.md.
  I independently derived its noncommutative block inverse, the Schur test
  T^*T<=cI iff TT^*<=cI, its completed-square identity, and the attained SDP
  dual proving center completeness. Phase two clarified an overbroad phrase
  about products and a dual sign convention; the precise valid argument was
  already recoverable without changing any formula or certificate. The two
  selected scientific Python files are byte-identical across the freeze.
  The final driver replaces nonfinite optional float displays with null for
  strict JSON; it does not change exact scientific fields.
